children: Spain's National Statistics Institute (INE) on Friday revised the country's 2025 gross domestic product growth rate downward to 2.6% from an initial 2.8%.
The INE also revised the 2024 annual GDP growth data higher, to 3.7% growth from 3.5% previously, and the 2023 data down to an expansion of 2.4% from a prior 2.5%.
